newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK three-year notes avg accepted yield 6.44 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK three-year notes avg accepted yield 6.44 pct.

text.p: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said the average accepted price of the three-year Exchange Fund notes tendered on Monday was 99.83 yielding 6.44 percent versus 6.81 percent at a previous tender on July 22.
Bids for the HK$500 million issue totalled HK$7.24 billion versus HK$6.67 billion at the last tender.
The lowest accepted yield was 6.44 percent while the average tendered yield was 6.46 percent, it said.
The notes carry a coupon of 6.28 percent and mature on October 15, 1999.
